gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioma; High Grade Glioma; Glioma, Malignant; Glioma Intracranial; Diffuse Glioma
Histopathology-proven HGG (WHO grade III-IV) or DMG (WHO grade IV)

gbm_population_flag.reason: Glioblastoma never named; inclusion allows 'HGG (WHO grade III-IV)', which could be read as historical grade IV glioma (D27C), but this is a paediatric HGG/DMG population without explicit GBM.

candidate_evidence.quote: 18F-Fluciclovine will be injected via IV prior to Positron emission tomography (PET)-Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)
The overall objective of this current application is to evaluate 18F-fluciclovine PET imaging as a diagnostic biomarker for tumor progression compared to post-treatment changes in pediatric HGG.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Participants with clinical and/or radiographic suspicion of True progression (TP) or Pseudoprogression (PsP) during radiation but yet to have the initial post-radiation MRI scan.

role_evidence.quote: 18F-Fluciclovine will be injected via IV prior to Positron emission tomography (PET)-Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-labelled amino acid PET imaging tracer (fluciclovine, Axumin)
arms: 18F-Fluciclovine PET-MRI in pediatric HGG or DMG participants

coder_notes: Diagnostic imaging study in paediatric/young adult (age >1 to <21) HGG and DMG. Only agent is a PET tracer (diagnostic). cns5_terminology coded historical because of 'WHO grade III-IV' grading without IDH; could also be unclear. Treatment setting is suspected progression vs pseudoprogression after radiation, so coded unclear. SUV uptake is an imaging diagnostic endpoint, not a molecular biomarker.
